items.title: Local generation, finite type, finite presentation, coherence, quasi-coherence and local freeness pass to tensor powers, exterior powers and symmetric powers
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file modules.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement collects six permanence assertions: local generation by sections, finite type, finite presentation, coherence, quasi-coherence and local freeness all pass from a module to its tensor, exterior and symmetric powers (author lemma at source lines 3599-3624, label lemma-tensor-algebra-permanence). The proof (source lines 3626-3675) reduces everything to the tensor powers through the permanence lemma for the tensor product and the fact that the exterior and symmetric powers are quotients of the tensor powers, disposes of local freeness by the algebraic statement, transfers finite presentation through an explicit presentation, and proves coherence by exhibiting the symmetric power as a quotient of a tensor power by the image of a map from a finite direct sum and invoking the stability of coherence under exact sequences (proof lines 3649-3674). The coherence argument is the content. H2.
